name: 19th Annual FTC Microeconomics Conference
organizer: FTC Bureau of Economics, Tobin Center for Economic Policy (Yale) and Georgetown University
venue: Georgetown University Capitol Campus, 125 E Street NW, Washington, DC 20001
conf_dates_note: In-person event with a live stream for remote viewers
submission_requirements: Abstract or completed paper by email to BE-Micro@ftc.gov (preference to completed papers); accepted participants provide a financial disclosure statement per Bureau of Economics guidelines. IO, information, health, behavioral economics, quantitative marketing and other applied micro
registration_fee: None (free and open to the public; government-issued photo ID required)
